subject: Air freight MUC-MIA with breakdown
body:
Hello,

please quote MUC to MIA, 4 boxes of medical device parts, 540 kg, 2.2 cbm, ready 26.11., we deliver to Munich airport. Cheapest option in EUR.

Please break the price down into air freight, fuel surcharge and security surcharge, each as its own amount, and state the all-in rate per kg.

Best regards
Dr. Eva Huber
